data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Sidonia, which means 'just' or 'fair'. In Greek mythology, Sidonia was a nymph who was the goddess of the sea and the guardian of sailors. The name has a noble and virtuous connotation, making it a fitting choice for a baby girl. The name Sidoney carries the meaning “Fair, just, noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sidoney usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, just, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
